why: Astra F-ASTRA-8: "Applying it to the hero would also remove its animation." hero-3d.glb ships 1 skin and 1 animation (the walk cycle); the pre-sidecar helper exported meshes only, with export_animations=False, so a hand re-export silently produced a static, unskinned hero. applyTransforms is false because export_apply would bake the armature modifier and freeze the rest pose into the mesh.
selectionWhy: hero-3d.blend also holds RenderGround (a 40-unit turntable floor) and REF_V4_{FRONT,BACK,LEFT,RIGHT} reference planes plus a camera and three lights. "all" swept the floor and the reference planes into the export (measured: 2 meshes, bounds ±40 instead of ±0.57), so the rigged profile names its two objects: the skinned mesh and its armature.
